description: Minimized malformed ScVal fixtures for the policy decoder. Each file is a valid XDR ScVal map that the production shape guard and PolicyConfig conversion must reject with the stable InvalidConfig error. They are byte-identical to the committed fuzz corpus entries named in `corpus_entry`, so reproducing a failure needs no regenerator.
reproduction: cargo +nightly fuzz run policy_config_deserialization --fuzz-dir fuzz -- tests/fixtures/malformed-scval/<file>

fixtures.shape: `assets` contains ScVal::Bool where the guard requires an address
`assets` contains a muxed account, which is not a Contract/Account address the guard admits
misspelled field key `allow_any_reciPient` and missing `asset_caps`, so the exact-field-set guard rejects it
